sources: https://smartapi.angelone.in/docs (SPA; sections: User, Orders, Portfolio, MarketData, Historical, OptionGreeks, Instruments, RateLimit, Exceptions)
notes: Login request/response match the official SmartAPI docs (loginByPassword). Data payloads use the field names and envelope of the docs' samples (quote FULL mode, getRMS, getPosition, getAllHolding, getOrderBook, getTradeBook, getCandleData, optionGreek, placeOrder/modifyOrder/cancelOrder); the docs' samples are for SBIN/TCS/RELIANCE, so option rows carry NIFTY tokens in the scrip-master format. Session tokens are added per fixture (creds.sessionToken) so manifest.creds stays logged-out for sessionLogin.test.mjs. Every token, id and name is a dummy.
